name: qw2gn5-answer-grid
goal: Prove equal-width responsive Tracker answer tiles in desktop and tablet, one column at phone widths, and preserve the Other answer modal.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Tracker 15:03 canary report: open Hub Home and the contextual ask in chat, or open the native Tracker inbox. Compare equal-width tiles at 1440/820 px and one tile per row at 390 px.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing Hub and native cases counted and clicked choices without checking their bounds. Strengthened the unchanged user flows to assert columns and equal tile widths after screenshot capture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The committed browser tests failed on harbor-mbp-2. Hub Home and chat failed the responsive grid assertions; the Mac inbox rendered one tile per row, and inbox rows exposed the option description.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared Hub Home and chat use a width-aware grid. The Mac and iPhone inbox list uses compact tiles and keeps option effects in the detail view. The repository design guidance documents the grid and Other dialog.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At 164e9d5bd3, the unchanged tests passed on the isolated app on harbor-mbp-2 using 1 Chromium worker. Hub: 7/7. Mac and iPhone inbox renderer: 3/3. Reviewed desktop, tablet and phone screenshots.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
